title: Sala sa Init, Sala sa Lamig
description: An ex-cop and a pickpocket, neighbors who despise each other, must work together to catch an assassin who is on a killing spree.

title: Agimat ni Pepe
description: Father Lozano finds Pepe, an infant, in the church and raises him. When Pepe gets older, he receives an amulet for his generosity and helps his teacher, Lourdes, and Chino fall for each other.

title: Brando Bandido
description: Brando Bandido seeks revenge on Don Venerando, an outlaw who betrayed and murdered his father.

title: Alfredo Sebastian
description: A peaceful farmer's life changes after half of his family is murdered.

title: Utol Kong Hoodlum
description: A modern-day Robin Hood who has a heart of gold is forced to kidnap wealthy children in order to rescue his parents.

title: Moron 5 and the Crying Lady
description: Five dimwitted buddies try to figure out who would frame them for murder and want to keep them in prison.

title: Kahit Ayaw Mo Na
description: Joey, a fashion designer, Mikey, a video blogger, and Ally, a composer, travel to Samar island, where they become friends and discover that they all have something in common.

title: Rizal sa Dapitan
description: Jose Rizal is exiled to Dapitan by Spanish authorities. While he attempts to adapt to his surroundings, he helps a few local residents and provides free education to the children.

title: Sa Isang Sulok Ng Mga Pangarap
description: A girl with a deformed face wishes for a man who loves her despite her imperfection. She meets a man who grooms her and pays for her plastic surgery, but in reality, he is making her impersonate another woman with whom he is having an affair.

title: Gumapang ka sa Lusak
description: Rachel agrees to stop her affair with the mayor if he releases her boyfriend from jail. However, he asks her boyfriend to kill a man for him in return.

title: From the Top
description: In the darkness of a soundproof recording studio, a conversation sparks between two voice actors who are dealing with a shared tragedy.

title: Double Barrel
description: Australian journalist Angie Davis and Peruvian surf guide Harold Koechlin work to help an oil-dominated town reach a more sustainable future.
